description: Implementation of bit array manipulation functions for setting, clearing, testing, and allocating bits within a bit array structure, including region operations and internal bundle management.

methods.name: setup_bundle_data
methods.description: Initializes bundle data structure with start/end indices, offsets, and masks based on bit array offset and size.

methods.name: match_region
methods.description: Checks if a specified region of bits in the bit array is all set or all clear, optionally returning the first mismatched bit offset.

methods.name: set_region
methods.description: Sets or clears a specified region of bits in the bit array, reusing bundle data if provided.
